privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.collectText: Your email address, the glucose readings, notes and checklist items you save, your language choice, and the dates you agreed to this notice and confirmed you are 18 or older.
privacy.whyText: To let you log in and keep your own diary and checklist. We do not sell your information or use it for adverts.
privacy.whoText: Only you. The app's administrator can see your information in the database only when strictly needed to fix a fault, and each time is recorded. Family members and caregivers cannot see your information in this version.
privacy.whereText: In a database run by Supabase in Frankfurt, Germany, which is outside South Africa. Sign-up emails are sent through Brevo.
privacy.howLongText: Until you delete a reading or your account. The app keeps no backup copies, so deleted information is gone for good and cannot be brought back.
privacy.deleteText: Delete a reading in your Diary, or choose Delete account on your Profile screen to delete everything straight away. To ask for a copy of your information, email the contact below.
privacy.healthText: Glucose readings are health information. By ticking "I agree to the Privacy Notice" you agree that we may store it for the reasons above.
privacy.contactText: Refilwe Segoe, Information Officer. Email address to be confirmed (see Section 13.3).

safety.emergencyTitle: In an emergency, get help now
safety.emergencyText: Call 112 from a cell phone or 10177 for an ambulance, or go to the nearest hospital. Do not wait for this app.
safety.note: Symptoms alone cannot confirm diabetes. Only a test at a clinic can.
